title: Generate import and cook restaurant kitchen Infinigen map
objective: Create a new Infinigen indoor restaurant kitchen scene around 1000 sqft, import it into the SpearSim Unreal project, cook/package it for Linux, and verify it is ready for spear live.
instructions: Use alias/name restaurant_kitchen_1000sqft unless a hard conflict forces a clearly reported alternative.
Target Unreal map path: /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/restaurant_kitchen_1000sqft/Maps/restaurant_kitchen_1000sqft and mesh dir /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/restaurant_kitchen_1000sqft/Meshes.

Generate an Infinigen indoor restaurant kitchen/catering kitchen style scene of roughly 1000 sqft: commercial kitchen equipment, counters/prep surfaces, sinks, storage/shelves, appliance-like geometry, service/circulation space, doors/windows where available, and neutral usable materials if the generator supports them.

Prefer a manageable export/import profile matching successful recent generated worlds: FBX/export resolution around 256 unless there is a documented reason to change it; keep complexity low enough to cook and run interactively.
Import with materials/textures enabled if practical for visual use; use auto collision or a documented collision approach suitable for live teleop.

After import, add or validate actual Unreal light actors suitable for dim restaurant-kitchen live flashlight testing if the imported scene lacks usable fixture lights. Avoid baking in a fully bright room; the map should work with realistic live flashlight controls and dim scene-light scaling.

Cook/package the map into the active Linux Standalone-Development/Saved staged package using /home/yashturkar/Linux_Unreal_Engine_5.5.4 and verify both active archive and staged paks contain the target .umap and .uexp entries.
Do not run a display-dependent live SPEAR session unless DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY is available; if headless, provide the exact user command to run afterward.

Capture run logs, generator/source paths, FBX path, import validation counts, cook command, pak verification, and any quality caveats under a new .control-tower/runs/restaurant_kitchen_1000sqft_* directory.
constraints: Long-running process execution belongs to Experimenter; keep going through generation, export, import, cook, and verification unless blocked by missing Infinigen/Unreal prerequisites.
Do not delete unrelated generated worlds, Control Tower packet backlogs, or user assets.
If generation quality is visibly/structurally unsuitable for active illumination research, report that plainly and still provide the best available runnable result or the blocker.
expected_outputs: Generated Infinigen source path and FBX path
Imported Unreal map path and local asset paths
Cook/package verification that target map entries exist in active paks
A post-cook live command for the user, preferably spear live restaurant_kitchen_1000sqft --setting realistic-2x if/after the ledger can support it, otherwise the equivalent --map-path command
definition_of_done: Restaurant kitchen scene exists as an Unreal map under /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/restaurant_kitchen_1000sqft/Maps/restaurant_kitchen_1000sqft
Active Linux standalone paks include the target map .umap and .uexp
Tower has enough evidence to route Scribe/Builder follow-up for ledger/docs if needed
